text:
leila: FYI canary for notifications-service chart v4.1.0 started in us-east-1 at 11:03 UTC. I'm seeing a postop hook (notify-schema-check) failing in the canary.

deploy-bot: [automated] Deployment event for notifications-service:v4.1.0
Release: notifications-service.us-east-1
Canary: 10%
Hook: notify-schema-check -> FAILED (exit 2)
Logs: https://logs.internal/notifications/ef12bc34

tom: I checked logs — hook error is schema validation against external schema-registry: 422 Unprocessable Entity. Looks like the chart bumped the schema version in values.yaml (subchart alerts).

leila: 4.1.0 introduced stricter payload validation via the new schema. 4.1.1 contains a backward-compat flag but needs image rebuild. Options: pin to 4.0.7 for promotion, rollback the canary, or hotpatch chart to skip hook in canary.

eng-ops: Change window closes in ~40m. If we rollback now, we lose canary telemetry; pin keeps canary running and avoids re-applying CRs. Ops prefers pin to 4.0.7 and follow up with a hotpatch.

tom: Hotpatch to skip hook during canary requires changing the helm values and a chart rebuild for patch; might be slower than pin. Pin is fastest: add annotation deploybot.pin=notifications-service:4.0.7 on the release.

sophie: Quick risk check: is there any DB migration or CRD change in 4.1.0? Answer: no DB migrations, but the alerts subchart updated a CRD minor field. Skipping the hook in canary is acceptable short-term.

leila: Plan: 1) Apply manual pin annotation in us-east-1 to 4.0.7. 2) Run post-pin smoke: `curl -sS http://notifications-canary.internal/health | jq .` and check errors <0.3% latency <250ms. 3) Open PR for 4.1.1 hotpatch with back-compat flag and request fast security scan. 4) If hotpatch approved within window, promote 4.1.1, else promote 4.0.7 and schedule rollback of pin.

deploy-bot: [ack] Pin annotation received for notifications-service:4.0.7. Holding promotion. Pin job queued: https://deploy.internal/jobs/pin-5566

tom: I'll run the smoke once pin reconciles. Also will add a short release-note line: "Canary paused vs schema validation; pin to 4.0.7 pending hotpatch."

sophie: Notifying @support for customer messaging. Also filing ticket HOTPATCH-202 to track the 4.1.1 back-compat change.

deploy-bot: [update] Pin job completed at 1766001265. Promotion disabled by annotation. Canary remains at 10%. Recorded: RN-812, HOTPATCH-202.

leila: Smoke checks performed: health OK, errors 0.12%, p95 latency 118ms. No failing jobs. Marking rollout state: pinned -> pending hotpatch. Release notes PR: https://git.internal/release-notes/pull/612

tom: TL;DR: Manual pin applied to avoid schema validation failures during window; hotpatch in HOTPATCH-202. We prefer pin over rollback to preserve telemetry and avoid reapplying CRs.

sophie: Thanks all, will follow up on HOTPATCH-202 and update the release tracker. :white_check_mark:
